groupings.title: Code Quality
groupings.description: Refactoring verbs, architectural diagnosis, debt tracking, the pre/post gates that keep a behaviour-preserving sweep honest, and detectors for correctness smells, drifted duplicates, hidden errors, suppressions and type lies.

groupings.title: Security
groupings.description: OWASP-aligned detectors — injection, XSS, SSRF, file access, logic races, data exposure, SAST, IaC and CI pipelines as attack surface, secrets in history, dependency advisories, the on-device mobile lane, LLM trust boundaries and MCP servers — plus STRIDE threat modelling.

groupings.title: Testing
groupings.description: Coverage gaps, mutation strength, property-based invariants, consumer-driven contracts, test-data factories, golden-master characterization, and detectors for tests that cannot fail, flake sources, lying doubles and suites that never run.

groupings.title: Documentation
groupings.description: Catch docs that lie — dead-symbol references, stale diagrams, unrunnable quickstarts and samples, broken links and doc structure, undocumented public API.

groupings.title: Codebase Learning
groupings.description: The deep-extraction loop /setup-project runs to learn a codebase — architecture, domain entities, flows, emergent conventions, failure history — plus detectors for the AI knowledge layer: dead references, stale facts, context load, decision records and memory hygiene.

groupings.title: AI Engineering
groupings.description: Offline LLM eval harness detection and regression gating for RAG, prompt, and agent changes, plus read-only audits of LLM call sites, prompts, retrieval recall and vector indexes.

groupings.title: Algorithms
groupings.description: Mechanically derive time and space complexity — loop nesting, recurrences, amortized analysis — with a defensible big-O, plus detectors for super-linear work, broken algorithm contracts and numeric instability.

groupings.title: Codebase Alignment
groupings.description: Stack-conditional drift detection against a gold-standard inventory, the per-finding DETECT-DECIDE-FIX-VERIFY loop that closes it, and detectors for the convention oracle, naming and layout, wrapper adoption and convention ratchets.

groupings.title: Backend
groupings.description: API contract snapshots, endpoint verification, tenant-isolation debugging, module scaffolding, and read-only detectors for HTTP contracts, validation boundaries, edge errors, wire formats, state machines and job lifecycles.

groupings.title: Business Logic
groupings.description: Money rules, tax documents, ledgers, reports, lifecycle graphs and cross-feature business-cycle coverage.

groupings.title: Data Engineering
groupings.description: Detectors for derived data — incremental loads, orchestration DAGs, data tests, table contracts, lineage, extracts, rollups, personal-data copies and warehouse scan cost — plus a grain probe. /audit-data-quality runs them; /data-fix closes what they find.

groupings.title: Database
groupings.description: Seven code-first detectors (N+1, query shape, index coverage, schema integrity, migration safety, transactions, connections), ORM-vs-reality drift, and migration rehearsal against prod-sized data.

groupings.title: Delivery
groupings.description: The backend, frontend and mobile build lanes an /add-feature delivery run reads.

groupings.title: DevOps
groupings.description: Pipeline integrity and caches, release integrity, deploy safety, container builds and compose, GitOps drift, deploy monitoring, progressive delivery, and container supply-chain gating.

groupings.title: Distributed Systems
groupings.description: Read-only detectors for messaging, dual writes, event contracts, retries and deadlines, coordination and durable workflows, plus chaos injection against a running service and safe dead-letter-queue replay.

groupings.title: FinOps
groupings.description: Spend detectors over code and config — paid-API paths, storage growth, egress, allocation tags, budget guardrails — plus candidate pricing, commitment coverage, unit cost and spend-anomaly triage from a billing export.

groupings.title: Frontend
groupings.description: Code-first detectors for WCAG source defects, UI request races, routing, i18n and render correctness, plus Core Web Vitals scanners (LCP, critical path, images, fonts, SEO, SSR, navigation), bundle analysis and live Playwright verification. /frontend-audit runs them; /frontend-fix closes what they find.

groupings.title: Infrastructure
groupings.description: Offline detectors for rendered Kubernetes (render, availability, wiring, API versions), IaC state, lifecycle and deletion safety, data durability, serverless, IaC cost candidates, edge proxies, DNS/TLS lifecycle and network correctness, plus the saved-plan verdict, a live cluster audit behind a context halt and admission policy. /infra-audit runs them; /infra-fix closes what they find.

groupings.title: Migration (V1 to V2)
groupings.description: Per-feature V1 to V2 porting with parity guarantees — contract extraction, parity suites, data cutover, migration-time perf uplift — and paired-inventory detectors for surface, semantics, side-effect, parity-proof and cutover-routing gaps.

groupings.title: Mobile
groupings.description: Native accessibility, lifecycle (process death, permissions, push, OTA), render and startup cost, offline sync, the dated store gates, app size, bridge auditing, platform conventions and a device harness for simulator and emulator evidence. /mobile-audit runs them; /mobile-fix closes what they find.

groupings.title: Observability
groupings.description: Log, trace, metric and error-tracking detectors, alert-rule and SLO burn-rule lint, telemetry pipeline config, alert hygiene, SLO reality-checks, and synthetic/blackbox coverage of critical user journeys.

groupings.title: Performance
groupings.description: Endpoint profiling, load campaigns, memory-leak hunting, field Core Web Vitals with attribution, and detectors for request-path, caching and memory-growth defects.

groupings.title: Product
groupings.description: Half-built features, tracking-plan drift, plan-entitlement consistency, acceptance criteria, requirement evidence, ranked assumptions and the launch-readiness scorecard.

groupings.title: UI/UX
groupings.description: UI-state coverage and the state matrix behind gate G12, design-token drift, motion and reduced-motion, chart encoding, a fast a11y pass, the 19-verb closure vocabulary, screenshot design scoring and a pre-code design canvas.
